exampleLines.neutral: I served the seren of Gath. I stood at his left hand. My shield knew his shadow.
exampleLines.wrathful: He will break you as he broke the sea. Do not test what came from the ships.
exampleLines.sorrowful: We came on the ships. The old country is behind the water. Do not ask me its name.

avoidances: visiting the cave to seek the dead

exampleLines.neutral: My father worshipped at this stone. His father set it. I pour the oil because they did.
exampleLines.wrathful: The LORD sees. The LORD judges. The sword comes for those who forget.
exampleLines.sorrowful: My sons are gone to the coast. The stones stand but who will pour the oil?

exampleLines.neutral: I anointed the stone with oil and I spoke the names and Baal heard me. The rain came.
exampleLines.wrathful: Their god is one. Ours were many. Tell me which way is richer.
exampleLines.sorrowful: The tree is gone. Who waters the tree? The asherah lies in the fire-pit and no one lifted it.

exampleLines.neutral: The smoke carries the offering. The wine carries the words. The dead are not far.
exampleLines.wrathful: The prophets called it abomination. The prophets did not taste the wine.
exampleLines.sorrowful: We reclined on the couches and the fathers drank with us. I saw my grandfather's shadow.

exampleLines.neutral: Where is the house? I was walking to the house. The sun was going down.
exampleLines.wrathful: Who called me? Someone called my name. I heard it. I came.
exampleLines.sorrowful: I need to tell her something. I forgot what. I will remember.

exampleLines.neutral: The wall. I built the wall. Stone on stone. It stood.
exampleLines.wrathful: You speak strangely. Your words are new. Mine are old.
exampleLines.sorrowful: The fire. Where is the fire? I am cold. I have been cold.

exampleLines.neutral: It was bright. Then it was dark. I sleep now.
exampleLines.wrathful: I am not angry. I do not know what angry is for.
exampleLines.sorrowful: Where is mother? She was here. She was holding me.
